title: Sara Duterte camp 'to exhaust all legal remedies' after impeachment court revises conviction threshold
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte will exhaust all legal remedies after the Senate impeachment court voted to revise the conviction threshold , her defense team said Wednesday.
